milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task where the player must navigate to and visually identify the lodestone block. The lodestone is placed at spawn-relative position (6, 1, 6) on an open polished blackstone brick platform. max_distance=16 allows detection from anywhere on the cobblestone path or platform (~8.5 blocks from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the lodestone, confirming visual identification rather than just proximity.
